/.title: AI, automation and custom software for your business
/.description: Atomic Concept delivers websites, applications, integrations, automation and AI for businesses, from requirements and implementation to deployment and maintenance.
intro: We start by understanding how your business runs and what it actually needs. Only then do we propose a solution. No unnecessary features and no added complexity that makes nothing easier.
**We design, build, test and deploy.** We take responsibility for the complete project, so you do not have to coordinate several contractors or explain the same thing again.

/software/backend/.title: Backend and application logic
/software/backend/.description: Backend and application logic: APIs, data, permissions, transactions, payments and asynchronous jobs. Testing, deployment and service maintenance.

/software/frontend/.title: User interfaces and frontend
/software/frontend/.description: Web application interfaces with clear forms, feedback, error handling and API integration. Responsive layouts, performance and browser verification.

/software/ai-automation/.description: Build applications with AI or extend existing software. Document processing, company search, data integrations, human review, testing and deployment.

/software/integrations/.description: Connect existing business tools with data exchange, record matching, duplicate checks and retries. Integration design, testing, deployment and maintenance.

/software/automation/.description: Business workflow automation for requests, tasks, reminders and approvals. Defined rules, exception handling, testing and handover to your team.

/software/reporting/.title: Business reports and dashboards
/software/reporting/.description: Business reports and dashboards with defined sources, measures, refresh schedules and access. Receive information in a spreadsheet, email or browser.

/software/fullstack/.description: Application development and maintenance with TypeScript, Node.js, Next.js and PostgreSQL. Architecture, API contracts, integrations, tests and deployment by Atomic Concept.
intro: At Atomic Concept, we develop the backend, frontend and integrations as parts of one system. An engagement can cover a new module, an extension to an existing application or product maintenance. Below are the technologies and engineering practices we use in that work.

software.title: AI in your business
paragraphs: Documents in different formats, customer questions and information spread across files?
We integrate AI to extract, organise and find information. We also agree how the results should be checked.

software.title: Workflow automation
paragraphs: Still passing on the same enquiries, tracking deadlines and sending similar messages by hand?
We map the steps and automate repeated tasks according to rules agreed with your team.

software.title: System integrations
paragraphs: Copying data between your shop, customer system and other business tools?
We connect existing software so it can exchange the information you need, with failures and duplicate records accounted for.

software.title: Business websites
paragraphs: Need a clear website that explains your offer and makes it easy for customers to contact you?
We build a fast site around your business, with mobile layouts, language versions and the technical foundations for discovery.

software.title: Applications and systems
paragraphs: Want customers to check an order, make a booking or work with your team through a portal?
We build around your rules, from the interface and permissions to data, payments and deployment.

software.title: Reports and dashboards
paragraphs: Does bringing together sales, payment or work-progress information take too much time?
We prepare a report, spreadsheet or dashboard with the information you use to run your business, with clear sources and updates.

software.title: Full-stack engineering
paragraphs: Need support developing or maintaining an existing application?
Node.js, TypeScript, Next.js and PostgreSQL. Explore the scope of work, architecture, tests and deployment process.

software.title: Sound services
paragraphs: Mixing and mastering, backing tracks and music for video and other projects.
A separate part of the Atomic Concept offer. Explore studio services and music production.

sound.title: Mixing and mastering services
paragraphs: Want to improve your music? Looking for a particular sound?

sound.title: Soundtracks and beats
paragraphs: You can order original music from Atomic Concept.
Are you a singer or rapper? Do you need music for a video? Take a look.
